facts.recommendationText: Build a covenant and debt-service model and a proactive lender engagement plan Map covenant headroom, debt service, and maturities before any financing or operating move A covenant/debt-service model and lender engagement are analysis-only and reversible; they avoid taking on more debt to paper over a breach. The pressure is balance-sheet structural; the debt position must be modelled before any operating cut or new borrowing Build a covenant and debt-service model against the next test dates and the maturity profile. Covenant headroom and debt-service coverage modelled to the next test date Draft a lender engagement / waiver-or-refinancing plan before any covenant test is breached.
